title: Real fix for sl-cold-line-deadline: HDR/XHDR/XPAT of a non-overview header over a range (and any other served line whose payload reads are unbounded) must run in cursor quanta whose payload reads fit the realizer cache with margin (as OVER's fn-splan-cursor-step does), or answer from carried facts; until then the per-line deadline answers them 403 after read-dependency-ms. Also state the contract in ACL2: every served step's distinct payload reads are bounded below fn-arx-read-cache-entries
